items.title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
items.dek: Some 19 major Italian cities - including Rome, Milan and Naples - are already on red alert, and by Monday all but two will be.

items.title: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
items.dek: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.
